title: Page 7
content_zh:
这十人是各个少数民族的女子，其中有两人甚至拥有翡翠色的眼睛，皮肤又格外白哲，宛如传言中的妖精。这些女子是玄昱御驾亲征的战利品，从各个部族得来的极品美女。

随同这些女子来的看管嬷嬷将皇上的口信转述给原嘉宁：「皇上说，东宫实在太清静了，多些人热闹热闹也好，这些外族女子已不能生育，放着当玩物就行。」

玄昱的言外之意很清楚，完全针对原嘉宁：你自己独占太子好几年，新婚燕尔之期也早过去了，儿子和女儿你也都双全了，也该给太子再添几个女人装点一下门面，否则堂堂一国之储君，只守着一个女人过日子，那像什么样子？知情的人会说太子和太子妃夫妇鹣鲽情深，不知情的人，大概会猜测太子殿下被原府给操纵了，所以才不敢娶侧妃、纳妾室。堂堂太子却是个妻管严，以后还怎么登基？怎么管理群臣？怎么统治天下？

对于男人来说，人生的顶峰是什么？不就是权势、钱财、女人这几样吗？如果太子在女人方面表现得太过清心寡欲，人家不会夸他有节操，搞不好还会有人恶意猜测他是「寡人有疾」呢。

虽然替自家儿子送来了女人，但是玄昱还是顾及到自己的儿媳妇，送来的是不被允许生育皇族子弟的外族女子，这就绝对不会威胁到原嘉宁和她儿女们的身分地位，省了她很多事。

当然，这是玄昱自以为是的体贴，原嘉宁领不领情就是另外一回事了。

起码现在，原嘉宁盯着这十名美艳妖烧的异族大美女，心底烦躁郁闷得不得了。

不得不说，这几年她被玄渊宠坏了，脾气比做原府大小姐的时候还直率，遇到该生气的事就生气，一点也不会压抑。

所以她转头对玄渊气呼呼地说：「咱们的父皇是未卜先知吗？咱们刚给他送去一个小美人，他还未必收到呢，反而先给咱们赏赐了十个大美女，一换十，怎么算也是咱们赚了，你说是不是？」

玄渊忍不住笑起来，看她气得眼睛都要红了，说话也忍不住咬牙切齿，而且如果他要是再敢多看几眼那十名新鲜美人儿，只怕她都要跳起来咬他几口了。

此时玄渊反而不怎么对玄昱的多管闲事生气了，他慢慢地说：「是啊，父皇还是很疼咱们的，知道咱们东宫里缺少宴席待客用的歌舞伎，就亲自选送了十名过来，父皇的好意真是让我感动啊。」

原嘉宁将他的话在心底转了几圈，才总算明白了他的意思。

玄渊要把这些女人当做待客用的歌舞伎，不收纳她们进房了？

当时的风气使然，一些豪贵世家，往往会专门有一批家伎待客，这些家伎通常多才多艺，年轻貌美，获得了贵客的欢心之后，在两相情愿之下，也可以陪客人睡一睡，如果客人愿意赎买她们，主人家根据关系远近与身分高低，或送或换或卖都是可以的。

家伎与普通青楼妓院里的妓女相比，虽然都是伺候男人，但是她们的日子相对来说更轻松优闲一些，伺候的也都是或富或贵的主，不会三教九流的什么人都能碰她们。如果遇到心善的主人家，在她们年龄大了之后也会给一点嫁资，将她们嫁出去，后半生就不会太凄凉。

而皇家则有教坊司专门教导皇家御用的歌舞伎，在皇家各种庆典上表演歌舞，如果皇帝需要，也可依皇帝个别要求，私下献舞。

教坊司里的女子都是历年犯官的家眷，原本都是身分高贵的千金小姐，但家族一沦亡，她们也跟着没落，而且她们还不能赎身，除非皇帝特赦，否则她们的子孙也注定要为奴为伎。

玄渊也够狠，轻描淡写地就把这些渴望成为太子女人的异族美女，打落到与家伎一样的地位。

如果能够成为太子的女人，别说是有名分有级别了，哪怕只是个侍寝丫鬟，也比成为家伎强。

那十名异族美女有几个精通景国语言，听明白了玄渊话中的意思，脸色立刻就苍白了，而对玄渊的话似懂非懂的，看到其他人面色不对，也知道情况不对，跟着忐忑不安起来。

原嘉宁看着她们这副模样，也觉得怪可怜的，可是她更清楚对敌人的仁慈就是对自己的残忍，所以她绝对不能妇人之仁。而在她的眼里，凡是觊觎玄渊的女子，都是敌人。

所以她沉默了一会儿，转头对玄渊说：「那就这么办吧。不过她们终究是父皇赏赐的，还是劳烦太子殿下亲自去安排，我去看看妞妞。」

如果说，这些都是外人，原嘉宁还能容忍，但当云青萝也特地送来一名美女时，原嘉宁终于崩溃了。

这名美女正是最美好的二八年华，美貌罕见，就连原嘉宁这个女人第一眼见了都忍不住为之失神，想必对男人更有吸引力。

一开始原嘉宁还不肯相信，自家娘亲会送女人给自己女婿？结果她再三询问了原府来人，又看了云青萝的亲笔书信，这才终于死心。

云青萝的意思很明确，太子独宠太子妃，已经犯了众怒，现在燕京城里许多贵妇名媛都在暗中罗织太子妃和原府的各种恶名，如此下去，对原嘉宁极为不利。如果皇上和太子肯保护她还罢了，但如果那父子俩为了巩固皇位，不肯得罪众多官宦，尤其是玄昱，最擅长翻脸无情，也许转眼原嘉宁就会变成牺牲品。

云青萝明白，这些女人未必真的在意太子是不是独宠太子妃，她们或许有点嫉妒太子妃的好运，却还不会处心积虑地去对付原嘉宁，真正操纵她们的还是她们背后的男人，这些人想利用太子妃来打击太子，打击太子背后的原府，想除掉太子背后的大靠山。

正因为清楚意识到这一点，云青萝才知道自己女儿的确是身处险境。

云青萝的确极为在意男人的节操，但她更在意自家女儿的安危。

与自己女儿的性命相比，太子的节操算什么？

一直对太子夫妇放手不管的皇帝玄昱，突然出手就送给太子十个异族美女，其实也和这一波来势汹汹的舆论攻击有很大关系。

所以，云青萝也果断出手，亲自选了一个清白人家出身的绝色美女，简单调教之后就送了过来给原嘉宁，并且告诉她，这个女子身世坎坷，与被卖入青楼相比，她选择了卖身给云青萝，并且也自愿绝育了，所以多少可以信任，哪怕只是当个花瓶摆着，原嘉宁也要暂时把她摆起来。

没有人的生活能过得十全十美、称心如意，哪怕是帝王将相也各有各的烦恼。

原嘉宁明白这个道理，可是她依然无法接受母亲居然送来侍寝女子给她丈夫的事实。

她呆呆地坐着，任凭那名叫做戚玉瑶的绝色佳人跪在她跟前，戚玉瑶倒不害怕，反而颇有几分冷若冰霜的凛冽气质。

原嘉宁忽然很想问问母亲，当年发现叶姨娘的事情时，母亲是什么想法？而如果叶姨娘没有阴错阳差遇到皇帝，反而当真爬上了父亲的床时，母亲又会如何？

为什么每一代的女人总是会遇到这种让人难受得无法承受的事？

原嘉宁每每遇到和玄渊有关的事情时，总是容易掉眼泪，但这次她一直呆坐了半天，直到屋子里的光线都黯淡下来，她也没有再掉一滴泪。

在真正的难关面前，眼泪没有丝毫的价值。
content_en:
These ten people are women from various ethnic minorities, and two of them even have emerald eyes and extremely white skin, like the rumored fairies.These women are the trophies of Xuan Yu's personal conquests, the best beauties obtained from various tribes.

The caretaker who came with these women relayed the emperor's message to Yuan Jianing: "The emperor said that the East Palace is too quiet, and it would be nice to have more people lively and lively. These foreign women can no longer bear children and can be left as playthings."

The implication of Xuan Yu's words is very clear, and it is completely aimed at Yuan Jianing: You have monopolized the prince for several years, and the wedding period has long passed. You also have a son and a daughter. It is time to add a few more women to the prince to decorate the appearance. Otherwise, what would it be like for the prince of a country to live with only one woman?People who are in the know will say that the Crown Prince and the Crown Princess are deeply in love. People who are not in the know will probably guess that His Highness the Crown Prince has been manipulated by the Yuan Palace, so he does not dare to marry a concubine or have a concubine.The dignified prince is a strict wife, so how can he ascend the throne in the future?How to manage ministers?How to rule the world?

What is the pinnacle of life for a man?Isn’t it just power, money, and women?If the prince behaves too stoically when it comes to women, people will not praise him for his moral integrity, and maybe some people will maliciously speculate that he is a "little man with a disease".

Although he sent a woman for his son, Xuan Yu still took care of his daughter-in-law. He sent a foreign woman who was not allowed to give birth to royal children. This would definitely not threaten the status of Yuan Jianing and her children, and save her a lot of trouble.

Of course, this is Xuan Yu's self-righteous consideration. Whether Yuan Jianing appreciates it or not is another matter.

At least now, Yuan Jianing was staring at these ten beautiful foreign beauties, feeling extremely irritated and depressed.

It has to be said that she has been spoiled by Xuan Yuan in the past few years. Her temper is more outspoken than when she was the eldest lady of the original mansion. She gets angry when she encounters things that deserve to be angry, and she is not depressed at all.

So she turned to Xuan Yuan and said angrily: "Is our father a prophet of the future? We just sent him a little beauty, but he may not have received it yet. Instead, he rewarded us with ten beauties first. If we exchange them for ten, we will make a profit anyway, don't you think?"

Xuan Yuan couldn't help but laugh, seeing her so angry that his eyes were red, and he couldn't help but gnashed his teeth when he spoke. Moreover, if he dared to look at the ten fresh beauties a few more times, she was afraid that she would jump up and bite him a few times.

At this time, Xuan Yuan was no longer angry at Xuan Yu's meddling. He said slowly: "Yes, my father still loves us very much. Knowing that we lack kabuki in the East Palace for banquets, he personally sent ten of them to us. I am really touched by my father's kindness."

Yuan Jianing turned his words over in her heart several times before finally understanding what he meant.

Xuan Yuan wants to treat these women as kabuki for entertaining guests and won't admit them into his room?

Due to the custom at that time, some wealthy and aristocratic families often had a group of courtesans to entertain guests. These courtesans were usually versatile, young and beautiful. After winning the favor of the distinguished guests, they could also sleep with the guests if they wished. If the guests were willing to redeem them, the host could give them away, exchange them or sell them according to their relationship and status.

Compared with prostitutes in ordinary brothels, domestic prostitutes serve men, but their lives are relatively more relaxed and leisurely. They are also serving rich or noble masters, and anyone with no knowledge of the world can touch them.If you meet a kind-hearted host, they will give them a little dowry when they get older, and marry them off, so that the rest of their lives will not be too miserable.

The royal family has a teaching department who specializes in teaching royal kabuki and performs songs and dances at various royal celebrations. If the emperor needs it, he can also perform dances privately according to the emperor's individual requirements.

The women in the Jiaofang Division were all the family members of former convicts. They were originally noble ladies, but when their families fell, they also declined. Moreover, they could not redeem themselves. Unless the emperor granted amnesty, their descendants were destined to be slaves and slaves.

Xuan Yuan was ruthless enough to knock down these foreign beauties who aspired to become the prince's wife in an understatement, down to the same status as the servants of the family.

If she could become a prince's woman, let alone one with fame and rank, even if she was just a maid in bed, it would be better than becoming a housemaid.

Several of the ten foreign beauties were proficient in Jingguo's language. They understood the meaning of Xuan Yuan's words, and their faces immediately turned pale. However, they seemed to understand Xuan Yuan's words. When they saw the expressions on other people's faces, they also knew that something was wrong, and they became uneasy.

Looking at their appearance, Yuan Jianing also felt pitiful, but she knew better that kindness to the enemy was cruelty to herself, so she could never be kind to a woman.In her eyes, all women who covet Xuanyuan are enemies.

So she was silent for a while, then turned to Xuan Yuan and said: "Then let's do it. But after all, they are rewarded by the emperor, so I'd better trouble His Highness the Crown Prince to arrange it in person. I'll go see Niuniu."

If these were outsiders, Yuan Jianing could still tolerate them, but when Yun Qingluo also specially sent a beautiful woman, Yuan Jianing finally collapsed.

This beauty was in her best twenties and eight years. Her beauty was rare. Even Yuan Jianing, a woman who saw her for the first time, couldn't help but lose consciousness. She must be more attractive to men.

At first, Yuan Jianing refused to believe that her mother would give a woman to her son-in-law?As a result, she finally gave up after repeatedly asking who came from the original residence and reading Yun Qingluo's handwritten letter.

Yun Qingluo's meaning was very clear. The prince's doting on the princess alone had already offended the public. Now many ladies and ladies in Yanjing City were secretly trying to bring bad reputations to the prince and the Yuan Mansion. If this continued, it would be extremely detrimental to Yuan Jianing.If the emperor and the prince were willing to protect her, that would be fine, but if the father and son were unwilling to offend many officials in order to consolidate the throne, especially Xuan Yu, who was the best at being ruthless, Yuan Jianing might become a victim in the blink of an eye.

Yun Qingluo understands that these women may not really care whether the prince favors the prince alone. They may be a little jealous of the prince's good luck, but they will not deliberately deal with Yuan Jianing. The real manipulators are the men behind them. These people want to use the prince to attack the prince, attack the Yuan Mansion behind the prince, and want to get rid of the big backer behind the prince.

It was precisely because she was clearly aware of this that Yun Qingluo knew that her daughter was indeed in danger.

Yun Qingluo indeed cares deeply about a man's integrity, but she cares more about the safety of her daughter.

What is the prince's integrity compared to his daughter's life?

Emperor Xuan Yu, who had always left the prince and his wife alone, suddenly took action and gave the prince ten beauties of foreign races. In fact, it had a lot to do with this wave of fierce public opinion attacks.

Therefore, Yun Qingluo also acted decisively and personally selected a stunning beauty from an innocent family. After simple training, she sent it to Yuan Jianing and told her that this woman had a rough life experience. Rather than being sold into a brothel, she chose to sell herself to Yun Qingluo and was voluntarily sterilized, so she could be trusted. Even if she was just a vase, Yuan Jianing would temporarily display her.

No one can live a perfect life, even the emperors and generals have their own troubles.

Yuan Jianing understood this truth, but she still couldn't accept the fact that her mother actually sent a sleeping girl to her husband.

She sat blankly, letting the stunning beauty named Qi Yuyao kneel in front of her. Qi Yuyao was not afraid, but rather had a cold and frosty temperament.

Yuan Jianing suddenly wanted to ask her mother what she thought when she found out about Aunt Ye.And if Aunt Ye did not meet the emperor by mistake, but actually climbed into her father's bed, what would happen to her mother?

Why do women of every generation always encounter this kind of unbearable discomfort?

Yuan Jianing always sheds tears whenever she encounters things related to Xuan Yuan, but this time she sat there for a long time, until the light in the room dimmed, and she did not shed another tear.

In the face of real difficulties, tears have no value at all.
